newsitem.title: USA: ILC Tech to buy back shrs, mulls options.
newsitem.headline: ILC Tech to buy back shrs, mulls options.

text.p: ILC Technology Inc said Wednesday that it will begin a program to repurchase its own shares pursuant to a board authorization granted in November 1996, subject to prevailing market conditions.
In November, ILC said its board had authorized the repurchase of up to one million of its 4.8 million shares outstanding.

ILC also said that Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp is acting as financial adviser to assist in the ongoing evaluation of strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value, including opportunities for acquisition, merger, joint venture and other alternatives.
The company said it has no agreements or arrangements with any third parties.
